memory_candidates.content: When a postflight-style excursion/scope-check advisory needs to exempt a task's own working directory from a comparison without widening the check's own trigger condition, splice the implicit exemption into a LOCAL copy of the comparison set used only inside the existing guard -- never mutate the guard's own tested variable unconditionally before the guard runs. Mutating it upstream silently changes when the guard fires at all (e.g. causing a check to run even for inputs that previously skipped it entirely), which is a distinct defect class from the one being fixed.

When verify-deploy.sh or a nested test suite's gate fails during a concurrent multi-task /orchestrate cycle, root-cause with git log/git diff BEFORE assuming regression: check whether the failing file/path is in another concurrently-dispatched sibling's declared file_scope (in-flight uncommitted edit) or was committed by an unrelated, already-closed task (pre-existing condition). A reproducible direct invocation of the failing gate's own underlying command (bypassing the wrapping test harness) isolates which specific sub-check is responsible, distinguishing it from an unrelated co-located failure in the same nested run.
